content.short: Cronos is the leading EVM-compatible layer 1 blockchain network built on the Cosmos SDK.
content.description: Cronos is an EVM-compatible layer 1 blockchain built on the Cosmos SDK, backed by Crypto.com, Crypto.org, and a broad ecosystem of more than 400 app developers and partners. Its mission is to make it easy and safe for the next billion crypto users to adopt Web3, with a strong emphasis on DeFi and GameFi. Cronos seeks to simplify onboarding, deliver secure on-chain experiences, and enable scalable, interoperable applications across the fast-growing Web3 stack.
